name: cavemio-pricing-calculator
title: Pricing calculator
description: Drag to your size and watch the price roll, the plan morph and, at the top, “Let’s talk”.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The thumb is a real slider: Arrow keys nudge, Page Up/Down move a tenth, Home and End jump to the ends. Its value text reads the size and the price ("25K monthly active users, $96 a month").
- The plan is announced politely as you cross a tier; the rolling digits are hidden from screen readers.
- Pointer events with capture, so dragging works with mouse, pen and touch and keeps working outside the track.
- Installs Number roll, Text morph and Pricing toggle. With reduced motion the thumb and figures move in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: min / max / step
props.description: — / — / 1 · The range. On a log scale the step grows with the value (thousands near 10K, ten-thousands near 100K).

props.name: value / defaultValue / onValueChange
props.description: – · Control it, or let it keep its own.

props.name: price / plan
props.description: – · Your monthly price and plan name for a value.

props.name: marks
props.description: – · Ticks and labels along the track, e.g. where tiers change; clicking a label throws the thumb there.

props.name: scale
props.description: "linear" · Log spaces orders of magnitude evenly, so 1K, 10K and 100K get the same room.

props.name: unit / valueFormat / currency
props.description: — / — / "USD" · How the value and price read.

props.name: locales
props.description: the browser’s · Locale for every figure. Set it when the page renders on a server, so the server and the browser format prices alike.

props.name: contactFrom
props.description: – · From this value, "Let’s talk" replaces the price.

props.name: yearlyDiscount
props.description: – · e.g. 0.2 adds a Monthly/Yearly switch with "Save 20%".

props.name: cta
props.description: – · The button under the price; its words follow the plan.

useCases.title: Usage-based pricing
useCases.description: Prices that depend on API calls, seats, emails or monthly active users.

useCases.title: SaaS pricing pages
useCases.description: A slider above the plan cards that answers “what would I pay?”.

useCases.title: Sales-led top tiers
useCases.description: Past a certain size the price becomes “Let’s talk” and the button reads Contact sales.

useCases.title: Cost estimators
useCases.description: Storage, bandwidth or compute estimates before someone signs up.

features.title: Drag to your size
features.description: The thumb follows the pointer with the fill and a value bubble, and the price rolls digit by digit.

features.title: Your own formula
features.description: Pass price(value) and plan(value) and the calculator does the rest.

features.title: Linear or logarithmic
features.description: A log scale gives 1K, 10K and 100K the same room on the track.

features.title: Tier marks
features.description: Click a mark to throw the thumb there. Crossing a tier morphs the plan name and the button’s words.

features.title: “Let’s talk” at the top
features.description: From the value you choose, the price folds away and the button becomes Contact sales.

features.title: Monthly and yearly
features.description: Set a yearly discount and a switch rolls every figure. The slider reads out as “25K monthly active users, $96 a month”.

states.title: drag
states.description: The thumb, fill and value bubble track the pointer exactly; the price and the value roll (300ms while dragging).

states.title: jump
states.description: A press on the track, a mark’s label, Page Up/Down, Home or End throws the thumb to the new value over 520ms with a slight overshoot.

states.title: tier
states.description: Crossing a mark morphs the plan name and the button’s words and turns the mark white on the fill.

states.title: contact
states.description: At contactFrom the price folds to nothing through a 6px blur as "Let’s talk" opens in its place and the button turns to an outline "Contact sales".

states.title: yearly
states.description: The switch is thrown to Yearly; the monthly figure rolls down by the discount and the line under it morphs to "$2,995 billed yearly".
